memory_bridge: At one playground, a child raises and lowers both arms for full zǐ in 子女; when the same child runs after 孩 in 孩子, zi becomes a light suffix tagging along behind.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 子女 is a common modern anchor for this distinct reading.
readings.overlay: The 子女 child lowers both raised arms, then throws them back up; the gesture traces full third-tone zǐ.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 孩子 is a common modern anchor for this distinct reading.
readings.overlay: The child runs after 孩 and tags along in 孩子; final zi is light and neutral, like the smaller footsteps behind.
